DEFINITION · qeva:1:multiplication@1

Multiplication

Multiplication combines equal-sized groups by repeated addition.

editorialnumber-theory · arithmetic
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

Multiplication combines equal-sized groups by repeated addition.

EXACT

The compact statement

Recursively, mul(a,0)=0 and mul(a,S(b))=add(mul(a,b),a).

Example

3×4 is four additions of 3, giving 12.

Boundary / caveat

Multiplication in rings, matrices, and other structures may be noncommutative or differently typed.

Assumptions

  • The declared Peano-style arithmetic context is fixed.
